description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between "Ratio" and "minADE$_{20}$ ($\downarrow$)" across five different configurations. The x-axis represents the "Ratio" on a linear scale, with plotted values ranging from 0.1 to 1.0 and tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis represents "minADE$_{20}$ ($\downarrow$)" on a linear scale, with tick marks ranging from 0.55 to 0.75 at intervals of 0.05. All five lines in the plot are solid and use circular markers. The blue line, corresponding to an obscured legend entry, remains relatively steady across the x-axis, starting at approximately 0.605 at an x-value of 0.1, dipping slightly to 0.595 at an x-value of 0.3, and ending at 0.59 at an x-value of 1.0. The orange line, labeled "Head Tuning," shows a steady decline from a peak of roughly 0.785 at x=0.1 down to 0.685 at x=1.0. The green line, labeled "FT," exhibits a continuous decrease, starting at 0.685 at x=0.1, dropping to 0.63 at x=0.2, and concluding at the lowest overall value in the plot of approximately 0.525 at x=1.0. The red line, labeled "LoRA 16," declines from 0.74 at x=0.1 to 0.61 at x=0.7, experiences a very slight increase to 0.61 at x=0.9, and ends at 0.605 at x=1.0. Finally, the purple line, labeled "LoRA 64," closely follows the trajectory of the red line, decreasing steadily from 0.745 at x=0.1 to end at 0.605 at x=1.0.
